text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened on the day I attended a certain party
as Daiichi Ruby's Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text:
Lady Daiichi Ruby...! It is a true honor
to meet you in person like this for the first time.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful.
I am the one who is truly humbled to receive your greeting.

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text: Um... I've been sending fan letters every year. And this year's thank-you card was ex... ceptionally lovely!

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text: Whenever I send a fan letter to Lady Ruby, I receive a thank-you note in return.

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text:
It's a card stamped with Lady Ruby's handwritten signature...
I treasure it dearly, just like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look over the thank-you note presented to me.
It is remarkably simple—just a photo of her in her racing silk adorned with a golden signature—and yet—
choice_data_list: Are you going to send one to everyone who sent you a fan letter?
Are you sending one to everyone who sent you a fan letter?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is only proper etiquette in return for the expectations placed upon me.
My grandmother and mother did the same.

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes.
I've sent fan letters to everyone myself, and received replies each time. And—

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text: Lady Ruby is a new gem born into that very "Illustrious Family."

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text: From the very moment Lady Ruby was born, I have been a fan of her brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text: I continued to pray that Lady Ruby would be blessed with brilliant days, with happiness...

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text:
"And the first time I received a handwritten
thank-you letter from her—Lady Ruby was only three years old."

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text:
When I saw that clumsy yet admirable autograph written in hiragana...
I still haven't forgotten how deeply moved I was back then.
choice_data_list: Ever since you were that little...

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text:
Your penmanship has improved so beautifully now.
And that makes me... presumptuous as it is... truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ruby...
Thank you so much for always sending such wonderful thank-you letters.

text_block_list.name: Refined Lady
text_block_list.text:
From the very first letter I sent until now...
I have always been cheering on your path
from behind the scenes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Such words are far more than I deserve.
I shall engrave them deeply upon my heart.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I will deliver a performance worthy of my family's name... without fail. Please, enjoy the spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Learning yet another piece of the burden she carries fired me up all over again.
